partnerChallenge.agreement: B's v1 concern about circular setup and soft reflective project endings was well founded. The shorter bio, complementary first-person opening and replacement of those endings with contribution and factual detail materially improve that sequence. The neutral stills are appropriate support, and native text retains the whole meaning.
partnerChallenge.difference: My remaining emphasis is uneven specificity: Charms now offers a concrete timestamp/frame relationship, while Grok Bot mainly identifies the study, packaging and editions and eva.md states the continuity purpose and materials. B's independent emphasis was economy across README and pins. Some functional repetition remains there, but dependable destination summaries have a useful native-platform role. Neither concern calls for a full case study, more decoration or a louder character performance in this profile.
partnerChallenge.exactSharedRecommendation: Keep a concise greeting, honest public-work boundary, three destinations and one closing signature. The website expands this into question, contribution, decision and result with real evidence.
partnerChallenge.discussion: Exchanged a direct challenge with active Storyboard B after both inspected v2. B accepted the exact recommendation and challenged equal detail as a remedy: the three entries can serve different useful jobs, and full decision/result accounts would lengthen the phone route. I accepted that correction; my remaining specificity ceiling does not require uniform depth or longer blurbs. B also identified the adjacent 'things I've shared' sentence and heading echo, which I agree is minor. No substantive disagreement remains on the shared recommendation. This record supplies only my score; B supplies its own vote.

verification.method: Independently computed SHA-256 for the proposal, source manifest and all thirteen manifest-listed files; every file matched. Read all seven changed public files. Directly inspected the five required current PNGs with view_image and consulted all ten render-check records.
verification.boundary: Unchanged renderer, generator, design-system and image hashes establish continuity of the reviewed assets; this is not a new full renderer or animation audit. Render checks and PNGs are root-supplied local previews, not independent live publication observations.

changedJudgment.reason: The changes directly answer both earlier narrative deductions. The bio now carries a short subject list; the README adds Nag's figuring-out, making-useful and sharing motivation instead of repeating the former long positioning statement. The projects identify his contributions, and Charms adds a specific connection between notes and video evidence. In the updated 320 px scrolled view, the three destinations read as distinct paragraphs and the signature gives a clean ending; the 1440 px views retain the compact whole. The score increase is for those observed editorial improvements, not for reaching a threshold, unchanged artwork or proposed website work.
changedJudgment.continuityJudgment: The contract sensibly reserves question, contribution, decision and result for real website stories. Recognition is now stated as an intention, and the existing articulated rig is kept separate from legacy whole-character motion. These are clearer implementation constraints, not demonstrated website quality.

deductions.name: Project specificity is still uneven
deductions.finding: Charms supplies a tangible example of how the work presents evidence. Grok Bot and eva.md now identify contribution and intended use, but offer less of a particular making decision or observed result. Their introductions are credible and adequate; their narrative distinctiveness remains less developed.
deductions.criterion: Retain concise truthful copy. A later verified detail may strengthen one entry; the planned website is the appropriate place for a demonstrated question, decision and result. Do not fabricate impact or expand every blurb to case-study length.

deductions.name: The handoff to pins repeats some functional setup
deductions.finding: The native pins repeat project purpose, editions and continuity information soon after the README. The new first-person contribution framing differentiates the README better than v1, but the stacked route still has a small amount of editorial redundancy.
deductions.criterion: Keep useful standalone pin summaries and consistent names. In future maintenance, review bio, README and pins together and preserve distinct jobs for the personal invitation and the repository descriptions. This is not a reason to remove the native pins or the personal greeting.
